The '''language of the Flock''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] used by members of the [[Nediji]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on their homeworld of [[Nedij]]. Few non-Nediji spoke the language, although the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Squa Tront]] was able to. The language made use of laryngeal inflections.<ref name="MIIJH" />
